# Municipal Ordinance No. 13, Series of 1997

**Ordinance regarding inspection of residential houses with electrical wiring connections**

## Summary

This municipal ordinance grants authority to the [[Municipal Engineer]] and the [[Bureau of Fire Protection]] Officer, or their authorized representatives, to inspect all residential houses with electrical wiring connections every five years. It mandates homeowners to comply with recommendations for repairs within ten days, with failure to do so resulting in the cutting of electrical power. The ordinance also requires authorized representatives to show written authority and repeals any inconsistent ordinances.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** All residential houses with electrical wiring connections shall be inspected every five years by authorized inspectors of the local government.
2.  **Section 2.** The authorized inspectors are the [[Municipal Engineer]] and the [[Bureau of Fire Protection]] Officer or their authorized representatives who shall be the evaluators of the conditions of electrical wiring connections of every residential house.
3.  **Section 3.** Owners of residential houses with electrical wiring connections which need to be replaced as recommended by the authorized inspectors should comply within ten (10) days. Failure to obey will mean the immediate cutting of electrical power or line by the local government in coordination with the [[QUEZELCO]].
4.  **Section 4.** The authorized representative must show his written authority coming from the [[Municipal Engineer]] or [[Bureau of Fire Protection]] Office.
5.  **Section 5.** Repealing Clause - Any ordinance inconsistent herewith is hereby repealed accordingly.
6.  **Section 6.** This Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its approval.
